first.rationale: Onboarding completion is down 4% QoQ, and both memory_31 and memory_86 show that simplification directly lifts activation and completion. We need verification that the SMB signup field reduction and the broader completion improvements remain durable. Activation messaging (memory_91) is a secondary lever if the onboarding work succeeds. Promotional pricing (memory_73) addresses the competitor threat but risks margin and may not solve the underlying engagement problem. Referral incentives (memory_57) only work in established accounts and won't help acquisition velocity. Enterprise sales assist (memory_44) doesn't address the self-serve SMB friction driving our current decline. Simplifying onboarding directly targets both the completion drop and the activation decline through the proven path of reducing friction at entry.
